name: @frumu/tandem-client

hlido_opinion.headline: Robust AI agent framework with strong performance metrics — ideal for developers, but lacks extensive documentation.
hlido_opinion.body: The @frumu/tandem-client is a powerful AI agent framework that delivers impressive performance metrics, making it a strong choice for developers looking to build intelligent applications. Its capabilities are well-suited for various use cases, allowing for effective integration into existing systems. However, the documentation is not as comprehensive as one might expect, which could hinder new users from fully leveraging its potential. While the framework excels in functionality, the lack of extensive guides and examples may pose challenges for less experienced developers. Overall, it stands out as a reliable tool for those familiar with AI agent development but may require additional resources for broader accessibility.

tier_rationale: STEADY (90) due to its strong performance and established user base, indicating reliability and trustworthiness. It is not classified as VITAL because of the gaps in documentation that could limit usability for new developers. Improved documentation could elevate its tier status.
